headline: Approved updated PY52 Annual Action Plan and authorized the mayor to accept and spend Community Development Block Grant funds.
summary: Director Hazen gave an overview of the plan changes. Several members said they hoped future plans would build on these changes to further strengthen the program in the target areas.
decisions: Passed unanimously the order to approve the updated PY52 Annual Action Plan, submit it to HUD, and authorize the mayor to accept and expend Community Development Block Grant funds.

decision_evidence.quote: 1.ORDER TO APPROVE UPDATED PY52 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND SUBMIT SUCH DOCUMENTS TO HUD AND TO AUTHORIZE THE MAYOR TO ACCEPT AND EXPEND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT FUNDS Motion to open item 1 was made by Council member Parks and seconded by Council member Webber. Director Hazen provided an overview of the plan changes. Several Council members expressed appreciation for the changes and their hope that future plans would build upon them to further strengthen the program in the target areas. Vote: All in favor, item 1 passed unanimously.

decision_titles: Updated PY52 Annual Action Plan for Block Grant funds
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
 
ADMINISTRATION & SETTLEMENT COMMITTEE MEETING 
AUGUST 10, 2026 – MINUTES DRAFT 
 
Committee Chair: 
 Present -Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Vice Chair: 
 Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
 Present - Tasha Hunt 
 Present - Doug Foley 
 Present - Abdul Osmanu 
 Present - Adrian Webber 
 Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj. Leader 
 Present - Bob Anthony, Min. Leader 
 Present - Katie Kiely, President  
1.  CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Administration & Settlement Committee meeting, August 10, 2026 at 7:00pm was called to 
order at 7:24pm. The members noted above were in attendance. 
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to make public comment. 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming meetings for the Board of Ethics and Retirement Board was shared.  
There were no other Board, Committee or Department updates for this evening’s meeting. 
   
4. ACTION ITEMS   
 1.ORDER TO APPROVE UPDATED PY52 ANNUAL ACTION PLAN AND SUBMIT SUCH 
DOCUMENTS TO HUD AND TO AUTHORIZE THE MAYOR TO ACCEPT AND EXPEND 
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT FUNDS 
 
Motion to open item 1 was made by Council member Parks and seconded by Council member 
Webber.  Director Hazen provided an overview of the plan changes. Several Council members 
expressed appreciation for the changes and their hope that future plans would build upon them 
to further strengthen the program in the target areas. 
Vote: All in favor, item 1 passed unanimously. 
 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Caldwell adjourned at 7:51pm.
